mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 1.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which dampens consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%) combined with strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) signals a virtuous economic cycle that accelerates corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a sustained industrial production index above 105 signals overheating and imminent monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) indicates expanding labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1000 thousand units indicates weak residential demand, which reduces construction sector activity and consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.5%) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle economic expansions, a rising industrial production index above 105 indicates accelerating manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during early-cycle expansions when INDPRO > 105.
